quarterly_data.signal: IR Book 2026 (consolidated, KRW 100 million units): FY2025 AI-related revenue KRW 149.4 billion (68% of revenue) vs KRW 69.4 billion (40%) in 2024 and KRW 12.8 billion (9%) in 2023, while non-AI revenue fell to KRW 70.8 billion from KRW 105.1 billion. FY2025 by application: data center KRW 148.4 billion (67%, +88% YoY), smartphone KRW 49.0 billion, PC/notebook KRW 13.7 billion, automotive KRW 5.1 billion, wearables KRW 3.2 billion; by type: non-memory KRW 179.4 billion (83%), memory KRW 39.8 billion (+55%). The company claims the No. 1 global share in rubber test sockets, about 80% of socket revenue from overseas customers and 80% from non-memory, a 10-year technology gap over competitors, and an average two-week delivery lead time from in-house process and equipment (powder/silicone compounding, parts and mold making, socket molding and assembly).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 AI revenue KRW 149.4 billion (2024: KRW 69.4 billion); data center KRW 148.4 billion; non-memory KRW 179.4 billion; memory KRW 39.8 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Company targets in the IR Book 2026: scale-up milestones of AI revenue share 60% (with back-end solution portfolio expansion), then 70% (with a Vietnam plant expansion and process upgrades to sustain high profitability), then 80% together with the No. 1 global test-socket market share; ROE of 20% and an ESG rating of A in 2027, to be reached by growing high-value non-memory mass-production socket sales, operational improvement and cost reduction.
quarterly_data.figure: AI revenue share targets 60% / 70% / 80%; ROE 20% in 2027

quarterly_data.signal: AI test-socket roadmap in the IR Book 2026: memory sockets move from 0.27mm ball pitch (2024) to 0.25mm (2025) and 0.23mm/0.2mm (2026), then to HBM/HBF, stacked LPDDR and FO-PLP sockets in 2027-2030; system-chip sockets for AI computing and data-center advanced packages scale from about 7,000 I/O (NSP/TNSP, 2023) to about 15,000 and 25,000 I/O with the WiDER / WiDER-Flex / WiDER+ families (2025-2029, packages over 130-150mm), with next-generation chiplet, FO-PLP and glass-substrate sockets from 2030. Portfolio phase 3 (in progress) extends from sockets into testers for AI, CPO, 3D packaging and HBM/HBF test.
quarterly_data.figure: memory socket pitch 0.23mm / 0.2mm in 2026; system sockets up to about 25,000 I/O; HBM/HBF sockets 2027-2030
